subtitulo: What people speak at home is often not Italian at all — and six words of it buy more goodwill than a paragraph of standard Italian
cena: The two people serving you switched to something that is clearly not the Italian you have been learning, and it happened the moment they stopped talking to you.
frasePiso: You are not failing to understand Italian. You are listening to a different language, and noticing that is the whole skill.

fatosDatados.afirmacao: Italy's regional languages — among them Neapolitan, Sicilian, Venetian, Sardinian, Friulian and Piedmontese — are distinct Romance varieties descended in parallel with Tuscan rather than dialects of standard Italian. Several are recognised by UNESCO as vulnerable, and Italian law grants protected minority-language status to twelve historical linguistic minorities, including Sardinian, Friulian, German, Slovene, Albanian, Greek, Catalan, Croatian, French, Franco-Provençal, Occitan and Ladin.
fatosDatados.fonte: Legge 482/1999 — «Norme in materia di tutela delle minoranze linguistiche storiche»; UNESCO Atlas of the World's Languages in Danger

steps.pt: There is a moment in most trips where the language stops working. Usually it stopped being Italian.

steps.acao: That was not aimed at you and it was not standard Italian. Nothing has gone wrong with your ear.
steps.es: Uè, ma che vuo'? Vien' ccà nu poco.
steps.pt: Hey, what do you want? Come here a moment.
steps.tts: Uè, ma che vuo'? Vien' ccà nu poco.

steps.pt: What people speak among themselves is often a regional language, and they switch to Italian for you.
These are not corrupted Italian. They grew alongside Tuscan, and several are recognised as languages.

steps.acao: Venetian. Same country, unrecognisable words. That is the point of this part.
steps.es: Ciao, come xe? Tuto ben, va?
steps.pt: Hi, how is it? All good, yeah?
steps.tts: Ciao, come xe? Tuto ben, va?

steps.pt: You are not expected to learn any. But six words of the local one, said badly, buy something correct Italian does not.

steps.promptPt: Ask how you say something in the local language. Speak now.
steps.pt: How do you say it in dialect?

steps.acao: You just opened the best conversation available in the room. Repeat it back badly — that is the point.
steps.es: Ah, ti interessa? Allora senti qua...
steps.pt: Ah, you're interested? Then listen to this...
steps.tts: Ah, ti interessa? Allora senti qua...

steps.promptPt: Ask them to say it again so you can copy it. Speak now.
steps.pt: Say it again? I want to try.
Attempting it badly is the correct way to do this. Getting it right would be strange; trying is the compliment.

steps.promptPt: Say the local language sounds beautiful to you. Speak now.
steps.es: Mi piace come suona, è tutta un'altra lingua.
steps.pinyin: mee PYA-che KO-me SWO-na, eh TOOT-ta oo-NAL-tra LEEN-gwa
steps.pt: I like how it sounds, it's a completely different language.
steps.tts: Mi piace come suona, è tutta un'altra lingua.

steps.acao: The correction matters to them. Take it as information, not as a rebuke.
steps.es: Non è un dialetto, è una lingua. Mia nonna non parlava italiano.
steps.pt: It's not a dialect, it's a language. My grandmother didn't speak Italian.
steps.tts: Non è un dialetto, è una lingua. Mia nonna non parlava italiano.

steps.pt: That distinction is felt. Calling it a dialect is normal in Italy, and for some people it is exactly the wrong word.

steps.promptPt: Ask whether younger people still speak it. Speak now.
steps.pt: Do young people still speak it?

steps.promptPt: Ask whether they speak it at home. Speak now.
steps.pt: Do you speak it at home?

steps.promptPt: Try the phrase back and admit it came out badly. Speak now.
steps.pt: I said that terribly, didn't I?
A05 done. When Italian stops working it is often not Italian, and asking about it is the warmest question there is.

secoes.corpo: Neapolitan, Sicilian, Venetian, Sardinian and the rest descended from Latin alongside Tuscan, not from it. Standard Italian became the national language because Tuscan won a literary and political argument, not because the others were versions of it.

exemplos.pt: How do you say it in dialect?
Do young people still speak it?

secoes.corpo: Most Italians say dialetto casually, including about their own. Some, particularly speakers of the more distinct varieties, will correct you firmly. Both reactions are normal and neither is a trap — the correction is a piece of information about what it means to them.

Italian law recognises historical linguistic minorities including Sardinian, Friulian, Ladin, Slovene, German, French, Occitan, Albanian, Greek, Croatian, Catalan and Franco-Provençal. In parts of the country the local language has legal standing rather than only social presence.

Asking for a phrase and mangling it is the intended outcome. Fluency would be odd; the attempt is what registers as interest, and it is the fastest route to a long conversation with someone who was giving you three-word answers.

permissao: You are allowed to ask people to teach you a word of the local language, and to get it wrong out loud. Attempting it badly is not mockery — it is the single most reliably welcomed thing a visitor can do, and it is why this part exists at the end rather than the beginning.
espelho: Anyone whose grandparents spoke something at home that the school did not teach recognises this immediately. The pattern of a national language arriving over a local one is not Italian — it is just unusually visible there.

fichasCulturais.sinal: Two people serving you speak fluent Italian to you, then turn to each other and become completely incomprehensible.
fichasCulturais.suaLeitura: My Italian is worse than I thought, or they are deliberately excluding me.
fichasCulturais.oQueEAli: They almost certainly switched languages. Regional languages remain in everyday use for talking among themselves, and speaking Italian to you was the accommodation being made for your benefit.
fichasCulturais.oQueVoceFaz: Ask what they were speaking and how to say something in it. That question is nearly always received as flattering rather than as intrusive.
fichasCulturais.oQueMelhora: You stop grading your own comprehension against a language nobody was speaking, and you get the most enthusiastic conversation available in that room.
fichasCulturais.ondeNaoVale: Not universal — in much of the north and among younger urban speakers, standard Italian genuinely is the everyday language, and there may be no second one to ask about.
